column1: # Change-scoped test policy: which test layers a change needs (docs/TESTING.md). Read by scripts/test-scope.sh.
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are comments. Three kinds of row:
# path rows: FIRST match wins, so specific globs go above general ones. Glob as in bash [[ == ]]: * also crosses /.
#   A file no row matches is "unknown": the script asks for every layer and says so (the verifier decides).
# layers: comma list; "-" = none. A trailing ? makes a layer advisory ("consider": run it when the change could matter, see the why).
# content rows: a regex matched against block ids (minecraft:...) that the change ADDS to planner-core main sources or styles and that
#   appear nowhere in the base tree's planner-core/src/main: a block kind the generators never emitted before.
# Layer commands for heavy layers are run through scripts/evidence.sh <slug> <command> (CLAUDE.md "Parallel work").
# client-quick, client-full (FB_LAYER) and order (scripts/order-test.sh, dedicated servers) follow claude/p6-testlayers.
